_comment: positive: true/false. mods use the shared modifier format. compulsion: {tag, chance, text} forces the hero to handle curios with that tag by hand. steals: the hero pockets money and valuables from those curios. bar_lock: % chance to spend another week at the saloon after an expedition. after_battle_fatigue: Fatigue after every won or fled fight.

eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.desc: Can spot a jackrabbit at a mile.

beast_hunter.name: Beast Hunter
beast_hunter.desc: Knows where to put a bullet in anything with fur.

outlaw_hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
outlaw_hunter.desc: Has collected on a few wanted posters.

myth_buster.name: Unbeliever
myth_buster.desc: Doesn't believe in giants, and hits them just as hard.

trailwise.name: Trailwise
trailwise.desc: Reads the land like a newspaper.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.desc: Found a horseshoe once and never let it go.

hard_to_kill.name: Hard to Kill
hard_to_kill.desc: Has been left for dead twice. Came back both times.

rock_steady.name: Rock Steady
rock_steady.desc: Hard to rattle, hard to budge.

trail_hardened.name: Hard to Rattle
trail_hardened.desc: Seen too much to be shaken by much.

keen_eyed.name: Keen-Eyed
keen_eyed.desc: Notices the glint of gold in the dirt.

afraid_of_snakes.name: Spooked by Critters
afraid_of_snakes.desc: Anything with teeth and fur sets them jumping.

superstitious.name: Superstitious
superstitious.desc: Knows every bad omen by heart.

drinker.name: Drinker
drinker.desc: Can't pass up a bottle, in the field or back in town.

compulsion.text: can't resist and grabs the bottle

gold_fever.name: Gold Fever
gold_fever.desc: Sees gold in every creek bed, and keeps what they find.

compulsion.text: is overcome by gold fever and digs in

curious.name: Too Curious
curious.desc: Has to poke at everything strange.

compulsion.text: just has to take a closer look

frail.name: Frail
frail.desc: Never really recovered from the fever.

clumsy.name: Overweight
clumsy.desc: Carries a little extra, and it slows the hands and feet.

jumpy.name: Jumpy
jumpy.desc: Startles at every rustle in the grass.

nearsighted.name: Homesick
nearsighted.desc: Misses home more after every fight.

coward_streak.name: Maternal Instinct
coward_streak.desc: Holds back to look after everyone: hits softer, braces harder.

gloomy.name: Gloomy
gloomy.desc: Sees the dark side of every sunset.

hard_of_hearing.name: Hard of Hearing
hard_of_hearing.desc: Didn't hear the rattle. Didn't hear the ambush either.

manhunter.name: Manhunter
manhunter.desc: Once a target's named, they don't get away.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: Waits for an opening, then makes it count.

final_gambit.name: Final Gambit
final_gambit.desc: Nothing left to lose, and fights like it.

early_riser.name: Early Riser
early_riser.desc: Up and ready before anyone else.

lightning_rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning_rod.desc: Made to be shot at, and knows how to take it.

glass_jaw.name: Glass Jaw
glass_jaw.desc: Goes down easier than they'd like.

fainthearted.name: Fainthearted
fainthearted.desc: Falls apart when it gets close.

slow_starter.name: Slow Starter
slow_starter.desc: Takes a minute to get going.
